evidence.tension_with_section_10: Section 10 already says 'Never key presentation off weapon identity'. Section 11 reconciles rather than contradicts: section 10's argument is that DR weapons are unbounded and unenumerable, so per-weapon ANIMATION is impossible by construction. Appearance is keyed to CLASS, and SKILLS_BY_SET.Weapon is precisely the closed 14-entry set section 10 says identity lacks. Section 11 restates the line: appearance decides what mesh is held, never what it does.
evidence.registry_state: godot/assets/shared_asset_selections.json admits exactly two ids and both are scenery (dr.shared.tabletop-weathered-stone.scatter, dr.shared.kenney-nature.wood-narrow-bridge). So every weapon and armour class resolves to modelId: null today. Section 11 records that as the correct output rather than a gap, and states what admitting a mesh costs.
